name: squiggle-arrow

frames.best_why: All frames are nearly identical; frame 1 shows the arrow with its button and all three variants cleanly.

tagline: A wobbly hand-drawn arrow points the way to a button.
summary: A thin hand-drawn squiggle ending in a small arrowhead, meant to point at a nearby button or field. Three waveform styles and four directions, sized by width and height.
appearance: Thin white hand-drawn lines on black: a wavy arrow points right toward a cream Get started pill, with a tilted monospace "try it here" note before it. Below sit three more arrows, a bouncing right arrow, a smooth left arrow and a wavy downward arrow, each with a tiny grey caption.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The arrows are fixed drawings; width, height, direction and variant pick their size and shape.
demo_content: "try it here" note, a Get started button, and captions bouncy, smooth, left, wavy and down.
search_phrases: hand drawn arrow pointing at a button
sketchy arrow for a landing page
use_when: You want a hand-drawn arrow to nudge attention from a note toward a button or field.
avoid_when: The arrow must be precise or functional: it is a decorative squiggle, not a clear directional icon.
customise: width, height, strokeWidth, direction (right, left, up, down) and variant (wavy, bouncy, smooth) are props; the path shapes are fixed.
weight_why: Two SVG paths; nothing animates, loads or listens.

a11y.note: The SVG carries a title, but as a decorative pointer it is still announced as an image called Squiggly arrow.

issues: The small grey captions under the sample arrows are low contrast on black.
The decorative arrow carries a title, so screen readers announce it as an image.
polish_why: Charming hand-drawn shape and tidy variants; the demo is sparse and its labels are faint.
title: Squiggle Arrow
